title: Late-Addition Surcharge on Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation Mounting
content:
A late-addition surcharge applies to the priced labor of a Northgate Delivery & Installation wall-mounting charge at the Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation level — the labor fee for each television taken over the televisions as they are priced — as a percentage of the priced labor added to it. The percentage follows the calendar days from today to the appointment's currently booked delivery date:

| Calendar days from today to the currently booked delivery date | Surcharge added to the priced labor |
|---|---|
| Two days or fewer | 50 percent |
| Three to six days | 25 percent |
| Seven or more days | Nothing |

## Boundaries (hypothetical delivery date on the 20th)

| Today | Days to delivery | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| 18th | 2 | 50 percent |
| 17th | 3 | 25 percent |
| 14th | 6 | 25 percent |
| 13th | 7 | Nothing |

**Hypothetical figure.** Priced labor of $350.00 with 4 days to delivery carries 25 percent added: $350.00 plus $87.50, $437.50.
